root = Path('skill/point-taken')
install = Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Programs/Point Taken"
release = (install / "releases/latest.txt").read_text().strip()
profile = Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
claude = Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or profile / ".claude")
guide = Path(re.search(r'\[UI integration guide\]\(([^)]+)\)', (root / "SKILL.md").read_text())[1])

        assert (dest / relative).read_bytes() == (root / relative).read_bytes(), dest / relative
    print("Verified skill and guide:", dest)

from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

install = Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Programs/Point Taken"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pt-registration-") as folder:
    profile = Path(folder)
    env = dict(os.environ, USERPROFILE=str(profile), LOCALAPPDATA=str(profile / "local"), CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=str(profile / "custom-claude"))
    for run in range(2):
        subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(install / "Register-PointTakenUser.ps1"), "-RegisterOnly"], env=env, check=True)
        for dest in (profile / ".agents/skills/point-taken", profile / "custom-claude/skills/point-taken"):
            files = {f.relative_to(dest).as_posix() for f in dest.rglob("*") if f.is_file()}
            assert files == {"SKILL.md", "references/ui-integration.md"}, files
            for f in files:
                assert (dest / f).read_bytes() == (Path("skill/point-taken") / f).read_bytes()
print("Verified fresh and repeat registration with Windows PowerShell and a custom Claude config directory.")
